<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#EFF2F6"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="20" y="19" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#111111">9:41</text>
    <line x1="318" y1="17" x2="318" y2="13" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="323" y1="17" x2="323" y2="11" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="328" y1="17" x2="328" y2="9" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="340" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="342" y1="16" x2="345" y2="19" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="354" y="9" width="21" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#111111" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="376" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#111111"/>
    <rect x="356" y="11" width="15" height="7" rx="1" fill="#111111"/>
  </g>

  <!-- content surface -->
  <rect x="20" y="48" width="350" height="670" rx="2" fill="#C4C4C4" opacity="0.18"/>
  <rect x="20" y="46" width="350" height="670" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <g>
    <text x="195" y="104" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Welcome back</text>
    <text x="195" y="133" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#979797">Sign in to continue to your account</text>

    <text x="48" y="177" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#111111">Email address</text>
    <rect x="48" y="188" width="294" height="48" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.8"/>
    <text x="63" y="218" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#979797">you@example.com</text>

    <text x="48" y="272" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#111111">Password</text>
    <rect x="48" y="283" width="294" height="48" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.8"/>
    <text x="63" y="313" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#979797">Enter your password</text>
    <circle cx="315" cy="305" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#979797" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="315" cy="305" r="2" fill="#979797"/>
    <line x1="306" y1="315" x2="324" y2="295" stroke="#979797" stroke-width="1.2"/>

    <rect x="48" y="355" width="16" height="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polyline points="51,363 55,367 62,359" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="73" y="368" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5F5F">Remember me</text>
    <text x="342" y="368" text-anchor="end" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Forgot password?</text>

    <g>
      <rect x="48" y="397" width="294" height="50" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
      <text x="195" y="428" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Sign in</text>
    </g>

    <line x1="48" y1="478" x2="166" y2="478" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="224" y1="478" x2="342" y2="478" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="483" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#979797">OR</text>

    <g>
      <rect x="48" y="508" width="294" height="48" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
      <circle cx="78" cy="532" r="10" fill="#25213B"/>
      <text x="78" y="538" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">f</text>
      <text x="205" y="538" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#111111">Continue with Facebook</text>
    </g>

    <g>
      <rect x="48" y="570" width="294" height="48" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
      <circle cx="78" cy="594" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="78" y="600" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#111111">G</text>
      <text x="205" y="600" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#111111">Continue with Google</text>
    </g>

    <line x1="48" y1="655" x2="342" y2="655" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="687" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5F5F">New here? <tspan fill="#000000" font-weight="600">Create an account</tspan></text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="750" width="390" height="94" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="750" x2="390" y2="750" stroke="#000000" stroke-opacity="0.5" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,779 49,770 59,779" fill="none" stroke="#979797" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="42" y="778" width="14" height="12" fill="none" stroke="#979797" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="49" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#979797">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="130" cy="776" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#979797" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="130" cy="789" rx="12" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#979797" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="130" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#979797">Members</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="208" y="772" width="20" height="14" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#979797" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polygon points="213,786 213,791 218,786" fill="none" stroke="#979797" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="218" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#979797">Messages</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="313" cy="778" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="313" cy="775" r="3" fill="#000000"/>
    <ellipse cx="313" cy="784" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="313" y="812" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
